messages:
lena_csm: Heads-up: Rivulet onboarding shows stable p95 ~180ms but p99 spikes to ~1.1s on bursty short prompts. Their PM wants consistent <300ms UX. Thinking a targeted canary: route short prompts (<60 tokens) to compact-2b-int8 with prefix KV enabled and a 15-min TTL. Thoughts?

infra_bot: alert: customer=Rivulet window=10:10-10:30 p95=0.18s p99=1.10s spike=3.4x

arjun_re: +1. Add token-length normalization in the canary and preserve sampling params. Also capture tokenization diffs.

max_eng: I can deploy a 3-hour canary: 40% of short traffic to compact-2b-int8, 60% to standard-7b. Auto-spill to standard-3b if compact queue depth > 5. Will collect per-variant latency CDF, cache hit rate, and run automated eval on their seed prompts.

hannah_pdm: The customer is ok with tiny quality drift if latency and cost improve. Please include 25 golden prompts for manual QA.

arjun_re: Rollback criteria: if eval quality drops >1% or p99 increases vs baseline. Also surface any hallucination variance.

max_eng: Deploying config now (snippet):
```json
{
  "customer":"rivulet",
  "filter":"tokens<60",
  "split":{"compact-2b-int8":40,"standard-7b":60},
  "cache":{"prefix_kv":true,"ttl_sec":900},
  "spillover":"standard-3b"
}
```

infra_bot: canary started at 10:45 UTC. 30m update: median -20%, p95 -29%, p99 -25% for short prompts, cache_hit=41%, spillovers=2.0%

lena_csm: Great. If automated eval is within thresholds, we'll recommend gradual rollout and add the steps to the onboarding playbook. I'll coordinate the enablement session with the PM.

max_eng: Canary finished. Auto-eval delta = -0.2% quality, estimated cost savings ~34%. Marking PASS and recommending staged rollout.
